transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I keep getting this thought that I missed something during my cab safety check. Even when I know I did it, I worry somebody could get hurt, or my boss will think I lied. I can’t get the thought to stop while I’m driving or trying to study.
When you have these thoughts, do you find yourself going back to re-check the cab repeatedly to ease your worry?

Yeah. Before I take a ride, I keep circling the car and checking the tires, lights, doors, the meter, and my paperwork over and over. Sometimes I take pictures too. If it still doesn’t feel right, I start the whole check again, even if passengers are waiting and I’m already late.
